newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian Almaz source has no details on PGM dates.
newsitem.headline: Russian Almaz source has no details on PGM dates.

text.p: A source at Russia's Almazjuvelirexport, the state precious metals export agency, said on Friday there was no clear information on when Moscow would resume deliveries of platinum and palladium.
Japanese traders had said earlier this month the agency would resume exports under 1997 term contracts around June 20, but the source said there was no information to confirm this.
The agency also told Japanese clients last week it would resume PGM sales on the spot market in late June and deliveries to Japan under contracts around July 10.

But Almaz has kept markets guessing. It has been unable to state clearly and consistently when deliveries to Japan, the world's largest consumer of white metals, will resume, which has caused prices to skyrocket.

Russia accounts for 60 percent of the world's palladium supply and one-fifth of platinum deliveries. It has delayed shipments since the beginning of this year over what Russian officials have said are bureaucratic issues connected to the recent government reshuffle.
